data_quality.annotation_source: User confirmed in this chat that heater 0 was unplugged for this last 50 C run.
data_quality.applies_to: Entire run; no partial-run disconnect time was supplied.
data_quality.temperature_data: Original measured values retained. These describe the degraded-hardware experiment.
data_quality.original_power_fields: Software-commanded states, ON time and transitions; not measured electrical heat delivery.
data_quality.correction: Inferred heating state and heating ON time of heater 0 are zero. Other channels are assumed to deliver heat when commanded ON. Corrected count sums these inferred states.
data_quality.calibration_use: Not a healthy three-heater test. Use corrected/inferred delivered heating for modeling; do not use pi_output as actual power.
data_quality.limitations: No electrical-current/contact feedback. No counterfactual three-heater temperatures or performance can be reconstructed.
